scope: E29 A teacher ablation, B frozen local Reader, C teacher replacements; no QKV collection, frozen C/R4/phi/B16/Risk and Medium/M16/Q64
optimizer: Adam lr1e-4 betas(.9,.999) eps1e-8 wd0 clip1
network: same712->64 GELU->85, BF16 page coefficients, no increased capacity
local_loss: mean((mass*(r-rtrue))^2)/fixed_train_local_scale^2; fixed scale is median of train event weighted-target RMS; no per-page normalization cancelling mass weights
other_losses: E27-B beta Huber perpage targetRMS with frozen floor; gain Huber and0.1 listwise including no-op, state targetRMS floor, teacher temp0.3
selection: max summed actual Local-Online Set gain among four development epochs; teacher replacements not used
test_gate: both seeds and each dev trajectory positive summed Set gain; Set better than sameinfo Independent; >=20%Oracle recovery each; nonnegative per-event mean; degradation fraction <=15%, P10 and worst improve vs E27-B; doublecentered conditional correlation AND signflip recall improve vs E27-B each seed; all required
test: sealed until all gates pass; if passed evaluate frozen selected models once
teacher_A: Local-LOTO history + event-local current; missing correction means z=0,beta=0 so u=0, not true denominator; all teacher diagnostic
no_expansion: no lr/loss/rank/candidate tuning or extra updates after failure
normalization_note: local mass-MSE replaces centered Huber as explicitly requested; fixed target scale determined on train only, all other normalization matches E27-B
quality_gate_note: quantifies suggested significant reliability improvement conservatively before results; not claimed original E27 threshold
